fix_2_calibration_carveout_major.detail: (a) Wording consistency: tasks/1.md AC + Verification use `pytest tests/test_model_extractor.py -v -k 'not calibration'`; tasks/2.md AC + Verification use `python3 -m pytest -q -k 'not calibration'`; tasks/4.md Verification uses `python3 -m pytest -q -k 'not calibration'`. All three carry the same one-line caveat: calibration tests are red by design in Wave 1/2 because Task 3 rewrote the fixture and Task 6 (Wave 3) hasn't rewired the harness yet. (b) Confirmed via grep -rn 'def test.*[Cc]alib' across tests/ that, at the point Tasks 1/2/4 run (before Task 6 lands), only two test functions match the substring 'calibration': test_calibration_accuracy and test_calibration_real_pair_must_pass (both in tests/test_model_extractor.py, lines 332 and 363). No other test name, class name, or module name in tests/ contains 'calibration' (case-insensitive sweep also clean apart from docstrings/comments, which -k does not match against). So `-k 'not calibration'` excludes exactly the two intentionally-red tests and nothing else. (c) Confirmed tasks/6.md Verification Steps → Automated require plain `pytest tests/test_model_extractor.py -v` and `pytest -q` with NO '-k not calibration' carve-out — Task 6 explicitly rewires the harness to test_calibration_pair_tier_accuracy / test_calibration_sdcc_dupes_hard_block / test_calibration_not_dupes_never_hard_block and requires them green, consistent with tasks/10.md (Final Wave) which runs the full unscoped `pytest -q` plus a targeted `pytest tests/test_model_extractor.py -k calibration -v` referencing the new (Task-6-renamed) test names. The feature therefore ends fully green with no permanent carve-out.
